content: Best practice for polymorphic/variant records in Postgres is a hybrid model: common fields (id, tipo discriminator, precio, moneda, timestamps) as real columns, and the variant, per-type fields as a single jsonb column, optionally guarded by a CHECK jsonb_typeof(col)='object' constraint. This matches this project's existing reservas.detalle jsonb column (already built Phase 1) and its tipo discriminator column — Phase 2 should keep using detalle jsonb for the pasaje/hotel/tour/entrada-specific fields rather than adding per-type nullable columns or per-type tables.
